user.title: ADB TV
user.description: Open the ADB TV Server app on the TV: it shows its IP address and PIN.

zeroconf_confirm.title: TV found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found **{name}** at {host}. Enter the PIN shown by the ADB TV Server app on the TV.

reauth_confirm.title: PIN changed
reauth_confirm.description: The PIN for **{name}** has changed. Enter the new PIN shown on the TV.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Make sure the TV is on and the app is running.

init.title: Favorite apps
init.description: Each selected app becomes a switch: turning it on opens the app, turning it off goes back home. Use them with Alexa or Google ("Alexa, turn on Netflix").

abort.tv_offline: The TV is off or not responding. Turn it on and try again.

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Opens an app on the TV by name or package.

key.name: Key
key.description: Android key code without the KEYCODE_ prefix.

shell.name: Shell command
shell.description: Runs a shell command on the TV (like adb shell) and returns its output.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds before the command is cancelled.
